0.list: ban — code: HUN — what: Parliament voted to prohibit the production and marketing of cultivated meat, the second clear national ban in Europe. — caveat: The European Commission published a detailed opinion opposing it as unnecessary, since no cultivated product is authorised in the EU in any case.

1.list: ban — code: ITA — what: Law 172/2023, in force 16 December 2023. Prohibits production and marketing of cell-cultured food, and bars meat words on plant-based products. The first national ban anywhere. — caveat: Adopted before the EU scrutiny standstill period ended, which the European Commission has said makes its legal effect doubtful.

2.list: proposed — code: ROU — what: A prohibition modelled on Italy's was introduced in Parliament. — caveat: Not passed as of this compilation.

3.list: partial — code: FRA — what: A 2021 law bars cultivated meat from the canteens of schools, universities, hospitals and prisons. A wider ban was later introduced in Parliament. — caveat: The wider bill has not passed.

4.list:
US state ban — code: FL — what: SB 1084, signed May 2024. Unlawful to manufacture for sale, sell, hold or offer for sale, or distribute cultivated meat. First US state to act. A federal appeals court upheld it in March 2026.
US state ban — code: AL — what: Enacted 2024. Prohibits manufacture and sale of cell-cultured meat products, with a carve-out in the statute.
US state ban — code: MS — what: HB 1006, March 2025. Bans manufacturing, selling or distributing cultivated food products derived from animal cells. Passed unanimously.
US state ban — code: MT — what: Enacted 2025. Bans sale and manufacture of cell-cultured meat.
US state ban — code: NE — what: LB 246, 2025. First Midwestern state to prohibit sale or manufacture, paired with an executive order barring state agencies from buying it.
US state temporary — code: SD — what: SB 124, 2026. A five-year prohibition on sale, manufacture and distribution, following 2025 measures on labelling and state research funding.
US state temporary — code: IN — what: A two-year moratorium running to 30 June 2027, after which cultivated products sold in the state must be labelled an imitation meat product.
US state temporary — code: TX — what: Enacted 2025, seventh state to ban. Sunsets 1 September 2027 unless extended. Under legal challenge.
